Write the whole-module specification

module origen_202998 (
    input clk,
    output [2:0] SC_out,
    output [7:0] AC_out,
    output [3:0] PC_out,
    output [3:0] AR_out,
    output [7:0] IR_out,
    output [2:0] opcode_out,
    output I_out,
    output [7:0] M_out [0:15]
);

    reg [2:0] SC;
    reg [7:0] AC;
    reg [3:0] PC;
    reg [3:0] AR;
    reg [7:0] IR;
    reg [2:0] opcode;
    reg I;
    reg [7:0] M [0:15];
    reg IR0, IR1, IR2, IR3, IR4, IR5, IR6, IR7;

    initial begin
        // Initialize memory with instructions and data
        M[0] = 8'b10100010; // Load AC with value at address 2
        M[1] = 8'b01000001; // Add value at address 1 to AC
        M[2] = 8'd42;       // Data value
        M[3] = 8'd20;       // Data value
        // Add more memory initializations as needed
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        case (SC)
            3'b000: begin // Fetch instruction address
                AR = PC;
            end
            3'b001: begin // Fetch instruction
                PC = PC + 1;
                IR = M[AR];
            end
            3'b010: begin // Decode instruction
                opcode = IR[7:5];
                I = IR[4];
                AR = IR[3:0];
            end
            3'b011: begin // Fetch operand (if indirect)
                if (I) begin
                    AC = M[M[AR]];
                end
            end
            3'b100: begin // Execute instruction
                case (opcode)
                    3'b000: begin // Add
                        AC = AC + M[AR];
                    end
                    3'b001: begin // Subtract
                        AC = AC - M[AR];
                    end
                    3'b010: begin // XOR
                        AC = AC ^ M[AR];
                    end
                    3'b011: begin // Double
                        M[AR] = M[AR] << 1;
                    end
                    3'b100: begin // Load
                        AC = M[AR];
                    end
                    3'b101: begin // Store
                        M[AR] = AC;
                    end
                    3'b110: begin // Complement
                        M[AR] = ~M[AR];
                    end
                endcase
                SC = 3'b000; // Reset sequence counter
            end
            default: begin
                SC = 3'b000; // Reset sequence counter
            end
        endcase
    end

    assign SC_out = SC;
    assign AC_out = AC;
    assign PC_out = PC;
    assign AR_out = AR;
    assign IR_out = IR;
    assign opcode_out = opcode;
    assign I_out = I;
    assign M_out = M;

    assign {IR7, IR6, IR5, IR4, IR3, IR2, IR1, IR0} = IR;
endmodule
